english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for free time when you are not occupied with other activities.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for general free time or availability.

examples.english: I only have some leisure time after work.
examples.traditional: 我放工之後先有啲空閒時間。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6 sin1 jau5 di1 hung1 haan4 si4 gaan3

examples.english: I haven't had much availability lately.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 mou5 mat1 hung1 haan4 si4 gaan3
